audit.why: Every other field on the page already agrees the lane is favoured; only the enum disagrees. FAVOURED is a token already in use in ryze.full.js, so it applies cleanly.
audit.corrected: diff HARD -> FAVOURED. diffRating 4/10 and carryRating 5/10 left as they are.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 reads Ryze in both layers while whys[4] on the same row says Unstoppable Force changes the all-in calculus completely and to give him nothing to engage on.
audit.why: R is Malphite's spike, not Ryze's — Realm Warp adds macro, not duel power. The packet chart and the mirror both put Level 6 with Malphite.
audit.corrected: phases[4]/win[4] Ryze -> Malphite with rating 7/10 -> 3/10, as a matched pair. Other rows left alone — see questionsForUser, the mirror's summary and the packet disagree about Level 1 and 2+ items and I would not guess.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Point-blank root' appears in whys[1], spikes[0], early and wants.you[0]. Rune Prison is a 615-range targeted cast and it roots ONLY if Spell Flux is already on the target — otherwise it is a slow. Granite Shield, which absorbs up to 10% of his max health and recharges out of combat, is never mentioned anywhere.
audit.why: A player told he has a point-blank root will walk into 400-range Ground Slam and Thunderclap to use it, and will spend his opener into a shield that was free to strip with one Overload.
audit.corrected: Root restated at 615 with the Flux condition; Granite Shield named as the thing to break with a throwaway Overload before committing; Thunderclap's auto-reset wind-up flagged as the burst tell; Ground Slam's magic damage scaling off his armour noted as the reason his tank build still hurts.

edits.before: Rune Prison (W) comes online against a champion with zero dashes or escapes — a point-blank root into empowered Overload is a free trade Malphite cannot answer.
edits.after: Rune Prison lands from 615 on a champion with no dash — Spell Flux first so the cage roots instead of slowing, and the empowered Overload is a trade he cannot answer.

edits.before: W (Rune Prison) comes online — your first real threat vs an immobile tank who cannot dodge a point-blank root into empowered Q.
edits.after: Rune Prison arrives — your first real threat against an immobile tank, but it only roots once Spell Flux is on him, so lead with E.

edits.before: Root Malphite in place with W (Rune Prison) and immediately chain empowered Q into E Flux bounces — he cannot dash or dodge any of it
edits.after: Break Granite Shield with a throwaway Overload, then Spell Flux into Rune Prison so the root and the empowered chain land on bare health

edits.before: Seraph's Embrace and a second mana-AP item make your Flux loop permanent and your Overload hit for true burst into a zero-magic-resist target — you out-DPS and out-carry him in every extended teamfight.
edits.after: Seraph's and a second mana-AP item make the Flux loop permanent, and Overload's magic damage lands on an armour-stacker who never builds resist — you out-DPS and out-carry him in extended fights.

edits.before: Level 1 is a wash — you only have Q and must walk to melee range, while Malphite's Q slow costs him almost nothing to land. Farm safely from max range and bank Manaflow Band stacks; do not force a trade where he slows you and walks away healthy. At level 2 your first real leverage appears: Rune Prison is a point-blank root on an opponent who has zero mobility tools, meaning a clean W into empowered Q lands for free if you can close the gap while his Q is on cooldown. Level 3 is the payoff window — E on Malphite bounces Flux onto nearby minions and back, so a full E-Q-W rotation craters his HP through magic damage he has no resistance to build against. Force this pattern whenever his Q slow has just been burned: step in, E, empowered Q, W root, another empowered Q off the Flux mark, walk out.
edits.after: Level 1 is a wash — you only have Overload, while Seismic Shard steals move speed for three seconds on a flat 8 and costs him nothing. Farm from max range and bank Manaflow stacks. At level 2 your first leverage appears: Rune Prison reaches 615 on an opponent with no mobility, and with Spell Flux on him it roots rather than slows — so the chain lands free while his Q is down. Level 3 is the payoff — Flux bounces onto nearby minions and back, and the full rotation craters a champion who builds armour, not magic resist. Break Granite Shield with a throwaway Overload first; it absorbs a tenth of his health and recharges if you leave him alone. Then step in, E, empowered Q, root, empowered Q, walk out on the Phase Rush proc while his Seismic Shard is still down.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 tilt toward Malphite because his Q slow keeps you from freely walking into melee range, and pre-item mana costs mean you cannot spam your loop without draining dry. Play the wave: keep it slightly on your side so he has to approach you to farm, which shortens the gap you need to close for the W root. Do not burn your W defensively — it is your kill tool and repositioning it wastes your only engage. At level 6 Realm Warp adds a roam and escape threat but grants no combat steroid, so the solo lane does not flip; Malphite still controls the pace with Q slow and his R threat keeps you from diving freely. Treat 6 as the moment to apply pressure elsewhere rather than force a 1v1 he can interrupt with Unstoppable Force.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 tilt to Malphite: Seismic Shard steals your move speed every 8 seconds and pre-item mana costs stop you spamming the loop. Play the wave slightly on your side so he must walk to farm, shortening the gap you close for the root. Do not burn W defensively — it is your kill tool. Watch the Thunderclap wind-up rather than the cast; that reset is where his damage actually comes from, and Ground Slam scales its magic damage off the armour he is stacking. At 6 Realm Warp is macro only, so the duel does not flip while Unstoppable Force, 130 seconds at rank 1, is charged — pressure elsewhere instead of forcing a 1v1 he can interrupt. Take the plates his passivity gives you and keep stacking Tear.

notes: diff said HARD on a page whose own tone, rating and prose all say favoured at a 54.73% win rate — corrected to FAVOURED (a token already present in ryze.full.js; there is no EASY token). 'Point-blank root' was wrong in four places: Rune Prison is 615 range and only roots through Spell Flux. Granite Shield (10% max health, recharges out of combat) appeared nowhere despite deciding whether your opener connects. Only the Level 6 row was flipped — see questionsForUser for why I left Level 1 and 2+ items alone.
